isomorphisms.name: Conjugate Pair Dynamic Entanglement to Physical Interaction
isomorphisms.chi_law: If two variables are conjugate, their Poisson bracket is 1, meaning a change in one induces a change in the other via Hamilton's equations.
isomorphisms.physics_process: In Hamiltonian mechanics, conjugate variables (q, p) satisfy dq/dt = ∂H/∂p, dp/dt = -∂H/∂q, so they are dynamically coupled.
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Each pair of laws (e.g., Gravitation and Relativity) are not independent but dynamically entangled: changing gravitational configuration forces change in relativistic frame.
isomorphisms.prediction: The dynamics of the ten variables should obey Hamilton's equations with a Hamiltonian that couples conjugate pairs.
physics_process_steps: Conjugate variables (q, p) defined.
Poisson bracket {q, p} = 1.
Hamilton's equations: dq/dt = ∂H/∂p, dp/dt = -∂H/∂q.
Change in q forces change in p and vice versa.
